subject: Onboarding: SFTP invoice push + VAT reverse-charge tagging (PO 7890)

Subject: Invoice delivery for PO 7890 — SFTP + VAT reverse-charge?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our AP team needs to confirm how Redwood will send invoices once we go live. Our preferred flow is an automated SFTP push (we ingest UBL/CSV nightly). Two quick questions: 

1) Can Redwood publish invoices to our SFTP host (details below) instead of email?
2) We operate under a reverse-charge VAT in several EU entities. Can the invoice include the reverse-charge VAT tag / VAT note in the invoice meta so our system maps it automatically?

We attached PO_7890.pdf for reference. If SFTP isn't feasible, a secure portal push (with a signed PDF copy emailed) would be our fallback.

SFTP host (test): sftp.horizon-sys.com, port 2222
AP contact: ap@horizon-sys.com

Can you confirm next steps and a small test file exchange?

Thanks,
Valerie Marshall
Sr. Procurement Ops | Horizon Systems
Attach: PO_7890.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Valerie Marshall <billing@horizon-sys.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Invoice delivery for PO 7890 — SFTP + VAT reverse-charge?

Olga — looping you in to own the onboarding. Valerie is asking for an SFTP push and a VAT reverse-charge marker on the invoice. Karthik, can you stay on the thread for the account side / go-live timeline.

Plan suggestion:
- Olga to propose required SFTP credentials, test key fingerprint, and sample payload (CSV + minimal UBL)
- Confirm where we place VAT tagging (invoice JSON/UBL extension field + a line-item note)
- If SFTP blocked by security, offer portal push with signed PDF and metadata in the payload

Valerie — thanks for the PO, we'll get back with a one-page onboarding checklist and a test file by EOD tomorrow.

—Markus

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
To: Valerie Marshall <billing@horizon-sys.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jan 2028 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for PO 7890 — SFTP + VAT reverse-charge?

Hi Valerie / team,

We can absolutely support SFTP push for invoices. Outline below and what we need from you to complete onboarding.

What Redwood will deliver (test -> prod):
- A nightly push (UTC 02:00) to your SFTP host: sftp.horizon-sys.com:2222 into /invoices/horizon/
- File formats: UBL 2.1 XML (primary) + CSV fallback (header mapping included)
- Metadata: invoice-level JSON file sidecar that includes fields: invoice_id, issued_date, total_gross, tax_breakdown, vat_tag "REVERSE_CHARGE" (this is how your ingest maps reverse-charge)
- Signed PDF: we can attach a signed PDF in the same package when requested (toggle per account)

What we need from Horizon (test):
- SFTP username + public key (please send the public key as sftp_test_key.pub)
- Path confirmation (we will write to /invoices/horizon/test/)
- A sample inbound mapping spec or example UBL that your system expects for reverse-charge mapping

Security notes:
- We will push via a dedicated outbound pool IP range and can whitelist on your firewall (list provided once onboarding starts).
- Files will be encrypted at rest and transferred over SFTP; we can also sign payloads with a detached signature if required.

Next steps / timeline:
1) You provide public key + confirm test path -> we produce a signed test file and drop it to test folder (target: 24–48h)
2) You confirm ingestion OK -> we schedule cutover to prod and add VAT tagging configuration

Attachments: sample_sftp_key.pub (please paste your key into a reply or upload to the secure intake link below).

If SFTP is blocked for any policy reason, we'll provide a portal push option and a one-off signed PDF drop via secure email.

Olga Petrov
Billing & Invoicing Lead | Redwood Inference
Attach: sftp_test_key.pub
Links: https://redwood.infra/ops/invoice-onboarding/INV-9221
From: Valerie Marshall <billing@horizon-sys.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@horizon-sys.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jan 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for PO 7890 — SFTP + VAT reverse-charge?

Thanks Olga — this looks good. We've attached our public key and a short sample mapping spec (excerpt) for the UBL reverse-charge element.

Public key: attached as sftp_test_key.pub
Mapping note excerpt: map /Invoice/TaxTotal/TaxSubtotal/TaxCategory/ID -> VAT_CODE, set VAT_NOTE = "Reverse charge applies — art. 194" when VAT_CODE = RC.

AP confirmed they will whitelist Redwood outbound IP range. We also need an initial test file and an example invoice (no financial obligation) to validate mapping before the official first invoice. Please proceed with the test push and confirm the exact path you will use.

Valerie Marshall
Sr. Procurement Ops | Horizon Systems
Attach: sftp_test_key.pub; Horizon_PO_7890.pdf
